Full job description

About Brightloom

Brightloom Analytics helps regional grocery chains forecast demand and reduce food waste. Our models run on point-of-sale data from more than 1,400 stores across the southern US, and our team of 85 is headquartered in downtown Austin.

What you'll do

  • Own the ingestion pipelines that bring in roughly 2 billion sales events a month from retailer systems.
  • Design and maintain our dbt models and the Postgres and BigQuery warehouses behind them.
  • Partner with data scientists to move forecasting features from notebooks into production.
  • Mentor two mid-level engineers and lead on-call improvements for the data platform.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years building production data pipelines in Python or Scala.
  • Deep SQL skills and experience with a cloud warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift).
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster.
  • Retail or supply-chain data experience is a plus.

Where you'll work

This is an on-site role at our Austin office (500 W 2nd St), Monday through Thursday, with flexible Fridays. It is not eligible for fully remote work.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $145,000 to $185,000 per year. Final offers depend on experience and interview performance. The role is also eligible for an annual bonus of up to 10% and equity.

Brightloom Analytics is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability or veteran status.
